digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical whole-file mutation score ceilings (e.g., 491 mutants in signing.py) are stale and must be replaced with per-shard bounded enforcement modes and evidence-based promotion.
Three enforcement modes (advisory head-only, ratchet base/head comparison, strict all-mutants-killed) with explicit promotion criteria allow phased rollout without blocking unrelated work.
Selector derives shard selection from changed source, test, support, and infrastructure files via commit diff, with fresh isolated base/head archives and no persisted mutation verdict cache.

Per-shard 30-minute job timeout, pinned mutmut 3.7.0, max-children=1, manifest-authoritative timeout values (1.0 constant + 15.0 multiplier), and clean-test preflight prevent stale cache hazards and guarantee reproducible evidence.
Documentation contract, selector JSON output, workflow matrix parity, and smoke-test verification prove the phased policy, promotion process, failure modes, and absence of legacy score tables.
